coordinates: PDF points, origin top-left, y grows downward. Underscore run: the character box. Drawn rule: x extent, y1 = bottom of the rule, y0 = y1 - 10. Box glyph: the character box.
how_measured: pdfplumber characters and thin filled rectangles (Chromium draws table borders as rectangles); both pages looked at at 100 dpi; overlays looked at.

signing.kind: The buyer completes page 1 and signs on page 2; a joint buyer gives name, tax ID, e-mail and address on page 1 but has no signature line; the company accepts on page 2.

sure_per_page.1: sure (the corporation choice has no printed box, so it gets none)
sure_per_page.2: sure of every place; which side of the two left rules each caption belongs to is a judgement (see doubt)

1: the "Corporation (Inc., LLC, LP) Please List all officers..." lines: no box and no blank is printed for them
browser header and footer (date, file name, URL, page n/2), and the stray underscore in the browser header and in the EX-99.2 line
2: the company name and delivery address (printed)
